meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 GitHub 机器人账号参与仓库讨论：当有人在 Pull Request 或 Issue 评论中 @ 该账号，它便回复，并持续回应之后同一讨论串的新评论。
howto.when: 当被监听仓库的 Pull Request 或 Issue 评论中出现对机器人账号的 @提及时触发；首次 @ 后，该讨论串会被订阅，后续所有评论都会得到回应。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 接进来，让机器人参与 PR 和 Issue 的评论。
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册通道，并引导填写凭据。

say.text: 我的仓库是私有的，请帮我配置 GitHub 通道。
请跑一遍 GitHub 通道测试，确认适配器就绪。
say.note: 会执行构建和注册测试，并汇报结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, your agent participates in GitHub PR/issue comment threads through a bot account. When @-mentioned, it replies; the thread is then subscribed and all follow-up comments get responses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @mentions the bot's exact username in a Pull Request or Issue comment on a monitored repo. After the first @-mention, the thread is subscribed and every subsequent comment triggers a response.

say_en.text: Add GitHub integration so the bot can reply in PR and issue threads.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and prompts for credentials.

say_en.text: My repo is private — set up the GitHub channel.
say_en.note: Uses 'public' sender policy; asks for the bot token and secret.

say_en.text: Run the GitHub channel tests to verify the adapter.
say_en.note: Runs the build and registration test, then reports the result.
